title: Configurational Taxonomy of Planetary Bodies: A Fuzzy-Set QCA of Orbital Hierarchy, Dynamical Dominance, Composition, and Evolution
domain: planetary science / comparative methods / set-theoretic analysis / taxonomy
summary: A falsification-first configurational taxonomy of Solar System bodies. The project uses crisp-set and fuzzy-set QCA as a set-theoretic classification tool—not as a vote on established labels—to test which combinations of orbital hierarchy, dynamical dominance, self-gravity/roundness, mass-size structure, composition, atmosphere, thermal-geological state, and stellar environment distinguish planets, dwarf planets, natural satellites, and small bodies. Mars is treated as a positive-control planet under the current IAU definition.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C user-requested project registered 2026-09-24. Initial framing separates definitional classification from causal inference, identifies Mars as a positive control rather than an unresolved planet-vs-satellite case, and freezes a first-pass variable-family and source plan.
